Hi Jen — thanks, happy to own the portal profile for Redwood.

Plan:
- I will set up the Vendr profile and mark the majority of CAIQ questions as N/A/Not Applicable where we have policy-level controls (we'll document rationale in the mapping sheet).
- For items that require evidence, we will provide an S3 staging bucket with short-lived links and a CSV manifest (see attachment names below).
- I'll loop in Security (Aditya) and Legal (Laura) on any control responses that might need redlines or policy text.

Deliverables I will upload by EOD Wednesday (3/17):
- CAIQ mapping (CAIQ_mapping_20270315.xlsx) with response rationale
- S3 evidence manifest (s3-evidence-manifest.csv) and pre-signed URLs for items marked 'Provided'
- Vendr profile created and initial Q&A completed with 'See mapping' where appropriate

Can you confirm the Vendr record id you want us to use or should we create a new record and notify you?

Attachments: CAIQ_mapping_20270315.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); s3-evidence-manifest.csv (text/csv)

Thanks, Monica — I pulled the initial evidence list. Quick summary of technical gaps and next steps: 

1) Identity: We can provide Okta SSO config screenshots and metadata (okta-metadata.xml) — available.
2) Logging: We have CloudWatch retention policy details; will export the retention config and a sample log export (sanitized).
3) Key management: Need to confirm KMS ARNs for customer-keyed disks; current note: we use AWS KMS with a customer-managed CMK for private deployments — I will confirm the ARNs by 3/16 noon.
4) Data residency: For hosted API customers we use multi-region but can confirm BrightBank's permitted regions.

I'll produce a folder in the shared Drive with filenames that match the manifest. Monica — when you upload the manifest to the Vendr record, tag each manifest row with the Drive link and the pre-signed S3 URL so BrightBank can easily fetch.

Attachments referenced: okta-metadata.xml (application/xml) — will live in Drive.

-Aditya
